## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always
frustrated when …"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Which build does this affect?

- [ ] **Teacher build** (Node/Docker — grading dashboard, executor, copilot)
- [ ] **Student build** (static SPA — peer review)
- [ ] Both

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've
considered, and why they don't work as well.

## Honest-scope check

SciPro Review ships two builds from one codebase, and the grading copilot is a
teacher-accelerator with a documented quality statement. Please note if your
request would change those boundaries (new execution semantics, provider
requirements such as a different embedding dimension, or a change to what a
human teacher must still review) — maintainers will weigh scope against the
project's stated limits.

## Additional context

Add any other context, links, or screenshots about the feature request here.
